result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the fixed bottom navigation obscures part of the next restaurant card.

issues.description: The category-chip row extends beyond the viewport, leaving a partially visible chip cut off on the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Keep the horizontal carousel intentional by adding clear scroll affordance or spacing, and ensure partially visible chips do not look accidentally truncated.

issues.description: The third “Fastest near you” restaurant card and its title are cut off by the right viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Use a controlled horizontal carousel with consistent card widths, right padding, and optional pagination/scroll indicators so the clipping reads as intentional.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation covers the lower portion of the next restaurant card, making the content appear abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the navigation bar height, or adjust the screenshot/scroll position so cards are not obscured.
